findings.title: Correction re-queues the row into a cadence dead-end: the sweep dispatches on the stale attempt_count (never reset), so the corrected referee never receives the fresh T0 invite, the applicant gets co-nudged every 15-min tick forever, and the row never advances or terminalizes
findings.location: server/src/reference_checks/sql/correct_reference_call.sql (no attempt_count reset) + server/src/reference_checks/sweep.gleam:255-268 (process_row dispatches on attempt_count) + sweep_claim_t0.sql (WHERE attempt_count = 0)
findings.evidence: correct_reference_call.sql: 'SET status = \'queued\', corrected_name..., correction_cycles = correction_cycles + 1, terminal_reason = NULL, next_attempt_at = now()...' (no attempt_count reset). sweep.gleam process_row: 'case row.attempt_count { 0 -> step_t0 ... 1 -> step_co_nudge ... 2 -> step_reminder ... }'. sweep_claim_t0: 'WHERE id = $1 AND status = \'queued\' AND attempt_count = 0'. After a T0 bounce (attempt_count=1) + correction (status=queued, next_attempt_at=now()), the sweep dispatches step_co_nudge (sends the APPLICANT co-nudge), then sweep_advance requires status='contact_initiated' AND attempt_count=1 — the row is queued → 0 rows → StoodDown; next_attempt_at unchanged → every tick repeats forever. The corrected referee is never re-invited (AC3 're-queues... the sweep owns the fresh invite' broken); exhaustion can never fire because no fresh invite is ever sent.
findings.detail: AD-7's one-cycle re-arm is broken: correct must reset attempt_count (and likely form_token) to 0 so step_t0 fires. Integration test correct_requeues... never runs the sweep afterward.
findings.recommended_fix: Reset attempt_count = 0 (and form_token = NULL) in correct_reference_call.sql; add a sweep-after-correct integration test pinning the fresh T0 invite to the corrected contact.

findings.title: Always-disabled action buttons: the enabled state renders attribute('disabled', '') which still disables the control — Start check / Take over / Save & resend / Save & send invite can never be clicked
findings.evidence: attribute("disabled", case busy { True -> "disabled" False -> "" }) at lines 769-771, 829-831; attribute("disabled", case saving { True -> "disabled" False -> "" }) at 994-996. Lustre vattr.to_string_tree: 'Attribute(name:, value: "", ..) -> string_tree.append(html, " " <> name)' renders a bare `disabled` attribute; reconciler.ffi.mjs #createAttribute: 'const valueOrDefault = value ?? ""; ... setAttribute(node, name, valueOrDefault)' — setAttribute('disabled','') leaves the attribute PRESENT → control disabled. Codebase pattern elsewhere (sweep_nudge_banner:134-135, unlock_consent_modal:148-149) omits the attribute entirely when enabled (False -> [] / attribute.none()). The client test inflight_disables_confirm_buttons_test only pins the busy case.
findings.detail: The RC4.3 action surface is permanently disabled in the browser; tests pass because they dispatch messages model-level and only assert disabled in the inflight case.
findings.recommended_fix: Use the codebase pattern: attribute present only when busy (e.g. case busy { True -> [attribute("disabled", "true")] False -> [] }) or attribute.disabled(busy).

findings.title: AR-RC13 regression: substitute action legality re-derived client-side from status; the shipped hooks.can_substitute_referee is never read
findings.evidence: overflow_actions: 'Unreachable -> [RefcheckTakeOver, RefcheckSubstitute]'; row_detail renders view_substitute_surface in the Objected and Unreachable case arms. Server ships can_substitute_referee: status == Objected || status == Unreachable (application_detail_handler.gleam:1101) and decodes it into ReferenceCallHooks, but grep of client/src shows the ONLY hooks read is '!call.hooks.can_record_manual' (reference_panel.gleam:135). The panel re-derives substitute legality from status exactly like the RC4.2 r1 is_terminal blocker pattern.
findings.detail: The server-computed hook exists precisely so the screen never re-derives (AR-RC13); the client ignores it and re-implements the rule from status.
findings.recommended_fix: Gate the substitute affordance on call.hooks.can_substitute_referee (and take-over on a shipped hook if one exists) instead of status-derived case arms.

findings.title: Em-dashes in 5 implementer-authored success toasts + em-dash joins in the attempt-log export text (RT em-dash ban; no_em_dash_test does not scan refcheck copy)
findings.evidence: copy.gleam:874 'Reference started — the invite goes out now.'; 878 'Reference re-enabled — it\'s back in the queue.'; 880 'You\'re handling this one — automated messages stopped.'; 882 'Details saved — the invitation is on its way again.'; 884 'Referee substituted — the new invitation is on its way.'; client.gleam build_attempt_log_text: 'attempt.at <> " — " <> attempt.channel <> " — " <> attempt.outcome'. copy_test.no_em_dash_test iterates for_each_copy → only copy.toast(code,ctx)/copy.page(code,ctx) — the refcheck_* consts are never scanned.
findings.detail: The RC4.2 r2 carried em-dash pin gap applies: new implementer-authored copy ships em-dashes and CI cannot catch them.
findings.recommended_fix: Rewrite the five toasts and the export joins without em-dashes (e.g. 'Reference started. The invite goes out now.'); extend no_em_dash_test to scan refcheck copy.

findings.title: Exhaustion notification names the REPLACED referee: notify_reference_correction_exhausted interpolates the raw snapshot contact_name, not the corrected name
findings.evidence: exhaust_row: 'notification_dispatch.notify_reference_correction_exhausted(db, landlord_id, reference_call_id, row.contact_name, row.applicant_full_name)'. find_reference_call_by_send_ref.sql selects 'rc.contact_name' (snapshot) with no corrected coalesce. notification_dispatch: 'let body = "Couldn't reach " <> referee_name <> ...'. The sweep SELECT (sweep_due_reference_calls.sql:31) coalesces corrected_name, but the exhaustion notification path does not.
findings.detail: After a correction that changes the referee's name, a second-failure notification announces the stale (replaced) referee to the landlord.
findings.recommended_fix: Select the effective name (COALESCE(NULLIF(corrected_name,''), contact_name)) in find_reference_call_by_send_ref / get_form_context_by_form_token and pass that to the notification.

findings.title: Stale/redelivered failure events defeat the one-cycle exhaustion gate: a duplicate bounce of the PRE-correction send exhausts the corrected row as unreachable and stamps a fabricated referee_contact_invalid fraud signal
findings.evidence: find_reference_call_by_send_ref matches 'rc.attempts @> NULLIF($1,'')::jsonb' — attempts is append-only, so the pre-correction delivered send_ref remains in the log; the WHERE status IN ('queued','contact_initiated') re-matches the corrected (re-queued live) row. webhooks: 'case row.correction_cycles >= 1 { True -> exhaust_row(...) }' → unreachable + stamp_referee_contact_invalid. A redelivered duplicate of the original bounce (Resend/svix at-least-once) therefore terminalizes the corrected row and stamps the fraud signal although the corrected contact was never tried.
findings.detail: The one-cycle gate counts the ORIGINAL failure twice (replay), not the corrected send. The correction's fresh send-ref is never distinguished from the old one.
findings.recommended_fix: Scope the find to the row's LATEST send_ref (or match on the corrected contact only after correction_cycles>=1) and dedup on the provider event id.

findings.title: Clearing one channel in the correction reverts to the failed snapshot contact: NULLIF(''→NULL) then corrected??snapshot fallback re-contacts the address that already failed (AD-7 never-re-contact violated)
findings.evidence: correct_reference_call.sql: 'corrected_email = NULLIF($4, \'\'), corrected_phone = NULLIF($5, \'\')'. sweep effective_email: 'case row.corrected_email { Some(e) -> Some(e) None -> row.contact_email }'. If the landlord clears the failed email (empty string), corrected_email becomes NULL and the sweep's effective contact falls back to the ORIGINAL failed contact_email — re-sending the invite to the address that bounced.
findings.detail: validate_trio allows email='' when phone is set; the corrected row then re-targets the dead channel, contradicting AD-7's never-re-contact-the-same-details rule.
findings.recommended_fix: Treat an explicitly cleared channel as an explicit exclusion (sentinel or a cleared-channel marker), or reject clearing a channel that previously failed.

findings.title: Failed correct/substitute leaves the §8.3 edit-trio save button permanently disabled: saving stays True, typing never resets it, only Cancel+reopen recovers
findings.evidence: ApiReturnedRefcheckAction Error branch only clears refcheck_action_inflight — refcheck_edit keeps saving: True. view_edit_trio: 'attribute("disabled", case saving { True -> "disabled" False -> "" })'. UserEditedRefcheckTrio updates name/email/phone but never resets saving. The Save button stays disabled until UserCancelledRefcheckEdit.
findings.detail: A transient failure (500/409) bricks the form's save affordance mid-session; retry requires cancel + re-type.
findings.recommended_fix: Reset saving: False (and clear the inflight marker) in the Error branch before toasting.

findings.title: Per-row 'Start this check now' is a silent no-op on the only state it is offered from (existing queued rows): 200 started:true, nothing created, no send, no re-arm
findings.evidence: insert_reference_call_if_absent.sql: 'ON CONFLICT (application_id, ref_slot, owner_label) WHERE status NOT IN (...) DO NOTHING RETURNING id::text' — for an EXISTING queued row the insert conflicts → 0 rows → Ok(None) → nothing created, nothing sent, next_attempt_at untouched; handler returns '{"started": true}'. The overflow menu offers Start only on Queued rows, which by definition already exist.
findings.detail: The §7.4 'sends the invite now' affordance cannot send anything: the idempotent create is a no-op on existing rows and the sweep owns all sends.
findings.recommended_fix: Either re-arm next_attempt_at = now() when the row exists (and let the sweep T0 it), or expose a true start-now transition; fix the misleading 'invite goes out now' toast.

findings.title: Overflow-menu choices open surfaces that are invisible when the row is collapsed: confirm/edit render only inside the expanded detail, and choosing an action never expands the row
findings.location: client/src/components/reference_panel.gleam:346-412 (view_row: confirm/edit render only inside `case is_expanded`); client/src/client.gleam:3006-3016 (auto-expand only FormCompleted/ManualRecorded/Partial), 3313-3389 (UserChoseRefcheckAction sets confirm/edit but never expands)
findings.evidence: view_row: 'case is_expanded { False -> element.none() True -> html.div(... [row_detail(call, app, confirm, edit, inflight), ...]) }' — the start/take-over confirms and the substitute/edit surfaces live inside row_detail. UserChoseRefcheckAction for RefcheckStart/TakeOver/Substitute only sets refcheck_confirm/refcheck_edit and closes the menu; the row stays collapsed → the affordance is invisible in the default (collapsed) state.
findings.detail: On a collapsed queued row (the default), clicking Start this check now appears to do nothing — the inline confirm never renders until the landlord manually expands the row.
findings.recommended_fix: Expand the row (set.insert(refcheck_expanded, call_id)) when an action opens a confirm/edit surface.

findings.title: Late-response guard claimed in comment but missing: stale ApiReturnedRefcheckAction toasts + refetches on any page — the id-match guard never checks the route
findings.location: client/src/client.gleam:3512-3552 (ApiReturnedRefcheckAction handler); comment at client/src/client.gleam:6583-6585; client/src/msg.gleam:274-275
findings.evidence: fire_refcheck_slot_action comment: 'the response rides ApiReturnedRefcheckAction with the call id + action name so a late answer after navigation is dropped by the id-match guard'. The handler: case result { Ok(_) -> clears state + toast + refetch_refcheck_effect(model); Error(err) -> toast } — no route check, no application-id comparison. A response arriving after the landlord navigated to another application still toasts + refetches.
findings.detail: The claimed stale-response protection does not exist; a late success refetches the wrong application's detail.
findings.recommended_fix: Capture the route/vid/aid when firing and drop the response if the route no longer matches.

findings.title: New RC4.3 panel state does NOT reset on route change although model.gleam documents 'All reset on route change (they are per-application surfaces)'
findings.location: client/src/model.gleam:370-377 (field docs + reset claim); client/src/client.gleam:657-680 (BrowserChangedUrl ApplicationDetail branch)
findings.evidence: model.gleam: 'refcheck_menu_open / refcheck_confirm / refcheck_edit / refcheck_action_inflight ... All reset on route change (they are per-application surfaces).' BrowserChangedUrl's ApplicationDetail branch resets refcheck_expanded + refcheck_explainer_open + report_download_loading but contains NO reset of refcheck_menu_open/refcheck_confirm/refcheck_edit/refcheck_action_inflight. refcheck_route_change_resets_expanded_rows_test (client_test.gleam:6255) only asserts expanded/explainer/auto_expanded.
findings.detail: A pending confirm, open edit form (with typed referee PII) or in-flight marker leaks across applicants; the model comment lies.
findings.recommended_fix: Reset the four RC4.3 fields in the ApplicationDetail route-change arm and extend the reset test.

findings.title: Path vacancy_id is never bound to the path application_id: a same-owner vacancy mismatch passes the prechecks, the application-trio UPDATE then silently 0-rows, and correct/substitute still return 200 + audit (also bypasses the archived-vacancy 422)
findings.evidence: run_action_with_prechecks verifies application ownership (app→landlord) and vacancy active (vacancy→landlord) but never that the URL vacancy_id EQUALS the application's vacancy_id. update_trio: 'UPDATE application SET ... WHERE id = $1 AND vacancy_id = $2 RETURNING id::text'. do_correct: 'case update_trio(...) { Error(err) -> Error(DbFailure(err)) Ok(_) -> ...audit... Ok(True) }' — the 0-row result is ignored; 200 + audit are returned with the app trio stale. A same-owner cross-vacancy id also evades the archived-vacancy 422 (the real vacancy may be archived while the passed one is active).
findings.detail: Malformed-request corner (client always sends the right id), but the handler returns success while silently skipping a documented side effect.
findings.recommended_fix: Verify vacancy_id matches the application's vacancy in prechecks, or treat update_trio's 0 rows as a 4xx with no audit.

findings.title: OldReferenceCallId/NewReferenceCallId added to NonPiiKey + to_string + test arms but never to the all_non_pii const — the new schema-test arms are dead code and the documented 'schema tests fail' guard silently passes
findings.evidence: all_non_pii const ends: 'PreviousStatus, RefSlot, ]' — no OldReferenceCallId/NewReferenceCallId. The test's non_pii_membership has arms for both (lines 92-93) but iterates 'list.each(schema.all_non_pii, fn(k) { non_pii_membership(k) |> should.be_true })' — since the const lacks the variants, the arms never fire. Docstring promises 'the exhaustive pattern match ... fails until done' — it cannot.
findings.detail: The audit-key registry invariant is silently broken for the two new keys; the substitution audit rows carry keys absent from the registry.
findings.recommended_fix: Append OldReferenceCallId, NewReferenceCallId to all_non_pii.

findings.title: Second-failure exhaustion is pinned only at the SQL level — the delivery-webhook and wrong-person call-site routing (correction_cycles >= 1 branches), the exhaustion audit, and the in-app notification have zero handler-level tests
findings.location: server/test/integration/reference_checks_actions_integration_test.gleam:491 (second_failure_exhausts_to_unreachable_with_signal_test — drives rc_sql.exhaust_reference_call directly); server/src/reference_checks/webhooks.gleam:285 (apply_delivery_failure correction_cycles>=1 branch); server/src/reference_checks/form_handler.gleam:1217 (apply_wrong_person correction_cycles>=1 branch)
findings.evidence: second_failure_exhausts_to_unreachable_with_signal_test calls rc_sql.correct_reference_call + rc_sql.exhaust_reference_call directly — it never goes through apply_delivery_failure or apply_wrong_person. Neither webhooks.gleam's exhaust branch nor form_handler's exhaust_wrong_person is driven by any test; their audit + notification side effects are unpinned.
findings.detail: A regression that flips or drops either live gate (both routes are load-bearing per the briefing) passes the entire suite.
findings.recommended_fix: Add handler-level integration tests driving apply_delivery_failure and apply_wrong_person through the second-failure path, asserting unreachable + stamp + audit + notification.

findings.title: Substituted referee rows skip the rc3-7 creation-time fraud screening (line-type lookup, contact-reuse checks) that the trigger applies to every created row
findings.evidence: substitute_reference_call.sql inserts contact_name/email/phone + next_attempt_at only — no fraud_signals stamp. trigger.gleam after create: 'stamp the creation-time fraud_signals on the NEWLY-CREATED rows only'. The substituted row never gets line_type/voip_or_burner or contact-reuse signals.
findings.detail: Inconsistent creation treatment; the fraud lens sees no signals for substituted referees.
findings.recommended_fix: Reuse the trigger's creation-time stamp for the substituted successor row.

findings.title: Takeover audit callsite bypasses the canonical Tier-2 fail-open helper, duplicating its observability inline
findings.evidence: write_action_audit: 'case audit_log.create(config.db, ...) { Ok(_) -> Nil Error(err) -> { wisp.log_error(...) sentry_client.capture(...) } }' — a bespoke fail-open duplicating audit/escalation.fail_open.
findings.detail: Minor DRY gap; behavior matches the established fail-open posture.
findings.recommended_fix: Reuse the canonical helper if it accepts arbitrary entity/event/detail.

findings.title: Take-over and substitute HTTP wiring never tested; the direct-handler legs pass a mismatched landlord uuid, so the 200/409s prove only that do_take_over/do_substitute ignore the landlord
findings.evidence: Both tests call actions_handler.do_take_over/do_substitute directly with landlord from a DIFFERENT create_rows (each seed_full_app seeds a fresh landlord via test_db.seed_landlord(db, 0)) — e.g. do_take_over(config, app2, landlord, call2) where landlord belongs to the first seed. The HTTP-layer prechecks (run_action_with_prechecks + ownership) are never exercised for take-over/substitute.
findings.detail: The authz chain (ownership + archived-vacancy 422) is only proven for handle_correct.
findings.recommended_fix: Drive take-over and substitute through their wisp/simulate HTTP handlers, including a cross-owner 404 and an archived-vacancy 422.

findings.title: terminal_reason-clearing assertion in the correct test is vacuous — the fixture never set a terminal_reason, so the assertion cannot detect a regression
findings.evidence: correct_requeues_with_corrected_contact_and_audits_test: 'row_field(db, call_id, "terminal_reason") |> should.equal(Some(""))' — the fixture (create_rows → trigger creation, then set_status which only updates status) never sets terminal_reason, so COALESCE(terminal_reason::text,'') is '' both before and after the correction.
findings.detail: The 'failure reason cleared' assertion is trivially green; a regression that stops clearing terminal_reason would not fail it.
findings.recommended_fix: Set a terminal_reason in the fixture before correcting, then assert it clears.

findings.title: refcheck_toast_action_failed is defined but never used — the action-error path routes through copy.toast(code, CtxRefcheckAction)
findings.evidence: grep: refcheck_toast_action_failed appears only at its definition. ApiReturnedRefcheckAction Error branch calls error_toast_copy(err, copy.CtxRefcheckAction).
findings.detail: Orphan constant.
findings.recommended_fix: Delete it or route the fallback through it.

findings.title: RefcheckCorrect overflow-menu arm is unreachable and mislabeled 'Substitute referee'
findings.evidence: view_overflow: 'RefcheckCorrect -> #(copy.refcheck_action_substitute, "correct")' — awaiting-correction rows have NO overflow menu (overflow_actions returns [] for AwaitingCorrection), so the arm can never render; its label is also wrong (shows substitute copy under the 'correct' testid).
findings.detail: Dead arm kept only for case totality; the label would mislead if ever reached.
findings.recommended_fix: Remove the arm or fix the label.

findings.title: Hardcoded error string in client.gleam while the success toast uses a copy.gleam constant
findings.evidence: The export error path inlines a string while refcheck_toast_exported lives in copy.gleam — copy-greppability regression.
findings.detail: Minor: user-facing string outside copy.gleam.
findings.recommended_fix: Move the error string into copy.gleam.

findings.title: Spec item 6's additive shared-keys enumeration omits corrected_name, contradicting the migration and code in the same diff
findings.evidence: Spec item 6 lists 'taken_over_at, contact_name, contact_email, contact_phone, corrected_email, corrected_phone, correction_cycles' — no corrected_name, while shared/src/shared/reference_call.gleam decodes corrected_name and the migration adds it.
findings.detail: Documentation drift only.
findings.recommended_fix: Add corrected_name to spec item 6.

findings.title: Spec Files list names files that don't exist under that name and miscounts new vs edited SQL
findings.evidence: Spec names 'update_application_referee_trio.sql' (singular) and 'client/test/components/reference_panel_actions_test.gleam' — the diff has three per-slot trio SQL files and tests inside reference_panel_test.gleam.
findings.detail: Implementation-artifact drift, not shipped code.
findings.recommended_fix: Update the spec Files list.

findings.title: Substitute SQL duplicates the existing idempotent insert instead of reusing it — the live-slot ON CONFLICT predicate is now maintained in three places
findings.evidence: Both files carry the same 'ON CONFLICT (application_id, ref_slot, owner_label) WHERE status NOT IN ('form_completed','unreachable','refused','objected','manual_recorded','failed','completed','partial')' — the predicate must stay byte-compatible with idx_reference_call_live in the base migration.
findings.detail: Three copies of a load-bearing predicate; a future terminal-state addition must touch all three.
findings.recommended_fix: Extract the conflict predicate (or reuse the pre-existing query via a shared helper).

findings.title: Concurrent substitute double-submit can return 409 instead of the documented 200 idempotent no-op
findings.evidence: The CTE's UNION ALL 'existing' arm is gated by 'AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM inserted)' — under a true concurrent double-submit, the loser's INSERT conflicts (0 rows) and its own inserted CTE is empty, but the winner's row may not be visible yet (READ COMMITTED), so the existing-arm SELECT can also return 0 rows → NotSubstitutable → 409. The sequential double-submit test (substitute_is_idempotent_and_guarded_test) passes.
findings.detail: Sub-second race; a retry by the client resolves it. Minor deviation from the 'double-submit returns 200' contract.
findings.recommended_fix: Accept the 409 (client already retries) or add ON CONFLICT DO UPDATE-free advisory lock.

findings.title: Sweep claim/advance guards lack a taken_over_at re-check: a take-over landing between the due-SELECT and the send does not stop the send
findings.location: server/src/reference_checks/sql/sweep_claim_t0.sql:29-31, sweep_advance.sql:22 (no taken_over_at in WHERE); sweep_due_reference_calls.sql:54 (the only taken_over_at gate)
findings.evidence: sweep_due_reference_calls.sql filters taken_over_at IS NULL at SELECT time; sweep_claim_t0/sweep_advance re-check only status + attempt_count. A take-over between the SELECT and the guarded UPDATE still delivers one invite/reminder and mints a token on a taken-over row. taken_over_row_is_excluded_from_the_sweep_test pins only the SELECT.
findings.detail: Sub-second window; one message may reach the referee after the landlord took over. The briefing's sweep-exclusion pin covers the SELECT, not the write boundary.
findings.recommended_fix: Add taken_over_at IS NULL to the claim/advance WHERE (belt-and-braces).

findings.title: Per-slot start: invalid ?slot= → 400 branch and the client's ?slot= wire format are untested
findings.evidence: per_slot_start_creates_only_the_requested_slot_test drives run_create_checks_slot only; the invalid-slot 400 (is_valid_slot False branch in handle_start) and slot_query parsing are unpinned.
findings.detail: Coverage gap on a new 400 branch.
findings.recommended_fix: Add a handle_start HTTP test with an invalid slot value asserting 400.

findings.title: Detail payload integration test does not assert the RC4.3 wire fields (taken_over_at / corrected_* / correction_cycles / contact trio)
findings.evidence: The RC4.3 additions to encode_reference_call have no positive wire assertion (the payload test asserts the strip sentinel and RC4.1 keys only).
findings.detail: A regression dropping the new keys from the payload would pass the suite.
findings.recommended_fix: Assert the RC4.3 keys in the detail payload test.

findings.title: schema_migration_test amended_columns_present_test not extended with the RC4.3 additive columns (corrected_name, correction_cycles)
findings.evidence: amended_columns_present_test lists ['draft_answers','taken_over_at','corrected_email','corrected_phone'] only.
findings.detail: Coverage gap for the expand-only migration additions.
findings.recommended_fix: Add corrected_name + correction_cycles to the list.

findings.title: correction_cycles is the only new detail key decoded without null tolerance — a null value would fail the whole payload decode
findings.evidence: detail_decoder: 'use correction_cycles <- decode.optional_field("correction_cycles", 0, decode.int)' — every other new key uses decode.optional(decode.string). The server encoder always sends json.int (column NOT NULL DEFAULT 0), so null is unreachable today; defensive only.
findings.detail: Robustness nit; the server contract cannot emit null for this key.
findings.recommended_fix: Use decode.optional(decode.int) with a 0 default for consistency.

findings.title: Fraud-signal stamp failure is log-only in the form exhaustion path but Sentry-captured in the webhook path
findings.evidence: webhooks exhaust_row: 'Error(err) -> capture(sentry, "ReferenceWebhookStampFailed", ...)'; form_handler exhaust_wrong_person: 'Error(err) -> wisp.log_error("reference wrong-person: fraud-signal stamp failed: ")'. Inconsistent observability on a compliance-relevant stamp.
findings.detail: A silent stamp failure in the wrong-person path would not reach Sentry.
findings.recommended_fix: Mirror the Sentry capture in the wrong-person stamp path.

findings.title: Take-over inline confirm body is not §7.7 verbatim despite the code comment and PR spec claiming 'verbatim': the referee's name is dropped from the sentence and 'he' becomes 'they'
findings.evidence: §7.7: 'Automated messages stop, and Colm's details + the attempt log are yours. If he completes the form anyway, it still shows up here.' Implemented: 'Automated messages stop, and the referee's details + the attempt log are yours. If they complete the form anyway, it still shows up here.' The name is rendered on a separate small line (reference_panel view_take_over_confirm).
findings.detail: Gender-neutral 'they' matches the rc4-2 W5 ruling; the name is still shown (own line). Deviation from the verbatim claim, minor.
findings.recommended_fix: Either interpolate the name into the body sentence or update the comment/spec claim.
